buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PFA/NER/GKP payable at Gorakhpur . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PFA/NER/GKP payable at Gorakhpur . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/NER/GKP A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder to note that Techno-commercial evaluation will be done on the basis of documents uploade d by the bidder & no additional documents will be considered at repre sentation time other than his torical documents in compliance to Para 7.3.5 of Manual for Procurement of Goods & services. 2. The bidder has to deposit EMD/PBG in the beneficiary's Name of "PFA/NER/GKP" and has to be sent t o this office address at "Office of the "Deputy Chief Material Manag er General Stores Depot, Gora k h pur-273012". 3. Onus of submission of required documents correctly at respective tab provided in GeM bid is on Bid ders. Bidder are advised to strictly adhered the same for techno-com mercial evaluation. 4. All the staff to be found in well dressed so that they can easily recognized. 5. In case any staff of contractor is found indulged in theft or any other such activity, cost of same sha ll be recovered from contractor’s bill without any prejudiced to other l egal options as deemed fit by Railway administration. 6. All applicable laws regarding engagement of staff by contractor shall be strictly followed by the con tractor and he shall indemnify the Railways form all claims, losses etc . arising out of the same. All c osts incurred by the Railway in this connection will be recoverable from the contractor. 7. In the case of death or injury to any manpower engaged by the service provider arising out of and in the course of performance of duties, the compensation etc. arising under any law for the time being in the force shall be sole liability of the service provider any and Railway will have nothing to do wit h it. 8. Bidder to note that service & payment to be done as per attached scope of work. 9. All the workers of Contractor/Service provider should be in proper dress with identity card. 10. The contractor/Service provider is liable to honor Central and State Government Laws & statutory R ules, Regulations, Notification and shall be solely responsible for any breach. 11. The contractor/Service provider shall execute all works as per scope of work and scheduled work all otted to do by Railway Administration. 12. The Contractor/Service provider shall provide well-mannered manpower capable of performing and supporting the functioning of the work given in the scope of work. 13. The Contractor/Service provider shall cover all the health problem of their worker. 14. The Contractor/Service provider shall not employ any person below the age of 18 years old. 15. During the work performing by Contractor/Service provider any loss or damage of Railway property service provider will be responsible and accordingly recover the cost of the same from firm's bill. 16. It is mandatory for Contractor/Service provider to submit the list of employee issued with ID and de ployed for execution of the work to the Railway at site before commeinincing of work. 17. Contractor/Service provider shall responsible to ensure compliance with the provision of minimum wages act 1948. 18. Payment will be made on a monthly basis. 19. Past Experience of Similar Services: The bidder must have successfully executed/completed similar Services over the last three years i.e. the current financial year and the last three financial years(en ding month of March prior to the bid opening): (A) Three similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 40% (forty per cent) of the estimated cost; or(B) Two similar completed se rvices costing not less than the amount equal to 50% (fifty percent) of the estimated cost; or (C) On e similar c ompleted service costing not less than the amount equal to 80% (eighty percent) of the e stimated cost. 20. Firm has to submit a duly fiilled, signed and stamped copy of Annexure (Rate of meal cooking charg e per plate) as attached under Para 6 of the Buyer Added ATC. 21. The bidders should mandatorily submit joint note copy attached in Para 6 of Buyer added specific te rms and conditions pertaining to site visit, without which the offer wi ll not be considered and will be summarily rejected. Name of the concerned supervisor with Designation & Contact No. are mention ed below: (1) Name of nominated co ncerned supervisor- Sh. Mitesh Kumar Singh(2) Designation - H ead Master/RPF Training Center (3) Mobile Number-9794840728. 22. Availability of office in Uttar Pradesh: firm has to submit documentary evidance i.e address mention ed in GST, valid deed, Electricity bill etc. wi thout this offer will not be considered and passed over. 23. Firm has to submit a duly signed and stamped copy of scope of work. In the absence of the above d ocuments, the offer of the firm shall not be considered and will be summarily rejected. . 6.
